connectionCategory.title: Connection Category Master
connectionCategory.description: Manage connection categories, billing frequencies, and billing methods

userManual.title: Connection Category Master — How It Works
userManual.desc1: Connection Category Master defines the billing categories, metered classifications, and frequency rules for water connections.
userManual.desc2: 1. Add connection categories (e.g. Regular, Slab Metered, Commercial Flat) along with their unique codes.
userManual.desc3: 2. Assign an appropriate billing frequency (e.g. Monthly, Quarterly, Annual) and billing method (e.g. Metered, Slab, Flat, Fixed).
userManual.desc4: 3. Set the metered status and active status of each connection category. Edit or delete existing categories as needed.
userManual.warning: Always ensure the connection category is Active if it is currently assigned to consumer water connections.
